name: Processor A
notes: Problem PS-O3 requires 9 qubits (5 items + 4 slack). Processor A has 5 qubits and is strictly non-executable under official rules.

name: Processor B
notes: Official reference architecture with bottleneck routing: high SWAP overhead due to degree-3 restriction and long tree branches.

name: Processor D (Our Design)
notes: Selected from 48 Pareto candidates. Slashes SWAPs by -41.2% (10 vs 17), depth by -25.6% (87 vs 117), with vertex-transitive symmetry.

name: Problem-Aware D
notes: Co-designed to place the strongest ZZ couplings (weights 8 and 4) on distance-1 physical links, optimizing two-qubit pulse dispersion.

name: Processor A (Shifted-Target)
notes: Reformulates the knapsack constraint without slack variables, compressing the register into 5 qubits to run on Processor A.
